MovementNudgeText: You've been focused for a while with barely any movement — a short stretch might help.
Quote1: You're not just studying — you're building the version of yourself that solves problems that don't have solutions yet.
Quote2: Every concept you understand today is a tool you'll reach for in the dark. Keep going.
Quote3: The confusion you feel right now? That's your brain rewiring. That's learning happening.
Quote4: You chose this path. On the hard days especially, that choice matters.
Quote5: Intelligence isn't given. It's built, session by session, exactly like this one.
Quote6: The model you train on yourself is the most important one you'll ever work on.
Quote7: Somewhere, a problem is waiting for someone who understands exactly what you're studying now.
Quote8: Uncertainty is the texture of growth. You're in it. Stay.
Quote9: Your future self is going to be grateful you didn't quit at this exact moment.
Quote10: The field needs people who think deeply. Be one of them.
Quote11: You're not behind. You're building at your own resolution.
Quote12: What you're doing right now is not small. It compounds.
TimerModeDesc_pomodoro: 25 minutes focus, 5 minute break. The original. Builds rhythm through repetition.
TimerModeDesc_flow: 52 minutes deep work, 17 minute recovery. Based on research into natural attention rhythms.
TimerModeDesc_ultradian: 90 minute cycles matching your brain's natural peaks. One session, one deep dive.
TimerModeDesc_claude: Adaptive focus blocks with AI-generated motivation. Your session, your energy.
TimerModeDesc_sprint: 10 minute intense micro-sprints with 3 minute resets. For when you need momentum fast.
TimerModeDesc_micro: 5 minutes focus, 1 minute break. Tiny steps for low-energy days or just getting unstuck.
TimerModeDesc_burst: 15 minutes focus, 3 minute break. More room than a sprint, still fast-paced.
TimerModeDesc_deepdive: 120 minutes focus, 20 minute break. For when you need to disappear into a problem.
TimerModeDesc_marathon: 180 minutes focus, 30 minute break. One long, uninterrupted push - exam-prep territory.
